autonomous trading agent on polymarket

zero code this time. the bot has its own computer in the cloud, its own browser, its own terminal. it trades with my laptop shut

every 10 minutes it:

→ scans 500-1000 markets
→ reads live X sentiment (it's grok, it sees every post on this app)
→ builds fair value, flags mispricing > 8%
→ calculates position size (kelly criterion, max 6% bankroll)
→ executes in its own browser
→ pays its own $200 subscription from profits

if the balance hits $0, i cancel the subscription. the bot dies

day one it dipped to $11. it dropped crypto and moved to weather markets, front-running NOAA updates

so it learned to survive

setup took one evening: create the bot, run one trade on your screen while it watches, put the skill on a schedule, connect telegram

no VPS. no API keys. no rust

last winter i built this exact system by hand. 3 weeks of rust. it made $2,980 in its first 48 hours

grok bot beat my own code in one evening

$50 → $5,273 in 48 hours
